hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['tool_input']['file_path'])"); case "$f" in *.py) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/ruff" format --quiet "$f";; esac 2>/dev/null || true

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { echo "=== handover.md (private, gitignored) ==="; cat handover.md 2>/dev/null || echo "(missing)"; echo; echo "=== PLAN.md Status ==="; sed -n "/^## Status/,/^## 1\./p" PLAN.md | sed "\$d"; } 2>/dev/null || true
